say.speaker: lord
say.text: Hey, wake up! Armed poachers are charging right across the prairie!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: *Yaaawn*... Oh, morning. Your satchel smells like sweet Oran Berries. Mind if I stretch my claws with your crew?

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Feed this youngster a few careful knockouts and watch how fast his strength blossoms!
